# Limassol Bus Schedule & Smart Route Planner

> Up-to-date public bus schedules, route planner, and transfer optimizer for Limassol, Cyprus (EMEL). Designed to help passengers find the fastest connections with minimal waiting times.

## About the Project

This web application provides real-time and static bus schedules for urban and suburban routes in Limassol, Cyprus.
Unlike standard timetable PDFs, the interface is specifically engineered around point-to-point navigation,
multi-leg transfer matching, and waiting-time minimization.

- **Geographic Coverage:** Limassol District, Cyprus (City center, tourist coast, suburbs, and regional villages).
- **Primary Operator:** EMEL (Limassol Passenger Transport Company).
- **Target Audience:** Residents, tourists, expats, and daily commuters in Limassol.
- **Languages:** English, Greek.

## Core Features

- [Smart Route Planner](/): Finds optimal A-to-B bus combinations with minimal transfer waiting times.

## Technical & Data Notes

- Schedule data is structured around official EMEL timetables and stop coordinates.
- Departure times represent scheduled stop arrivals.
- Popular hubs indexed: My Mall, Old Hospital, Saint Raphael Resort, Limassol Marina, Parklane, Germasogeia, Mouttagiaka, Agios Tychonas.
